mockup_note: No new screen. Two pure functions stop matching on a stage vocabulary that was renamed by Stage 1.
notes: The creator detail screen matched on stage names from before Stage 1. The two lists overlapped in exactly ONE value, so almost every collaboration rendered as closed with no actions.
root_cause: heroFor and sectionsFor switched on invites/applied/negotiating/active/tracking/completed/archive. deriveStage returns invitations/pitches/to_sign/shoot/content/done. Overlap: to_sign only. Everything else hit a default returning "Closed — This collab is closed" with no actions.
wider_than_reported: The founder reported a blank page on an invitation. shoot, content and done had the same fault, and sectionsFor did too — so a creator mid-shoot could not reach her contract, deliverables or earnings either.
the_sting: collabDetailModel.js carries a comment explaining that spineFor was DELETED by Stage 3 for this exact fault. heroFor sat directly above that comment with the identical defect.
and_the_tests_passed: collabDetailModel.test.js covered every branch by feeding heroFor the OLD names. Its own closing comment says exactly that about spineFor — written about the function two lines below, equally true of the one above. The file diagnosed itself and was not read.
my_own_wrong_diagnosis: I first reported the endpoint returning no row for her assignment. That was MY query run with the wrong second parameter — it takes [ciId, influencerId] and I passed the id twice. Re-run correctly it returns the row fine. Recorded because a confident wrong diagnosis is worse than none.

verification.checks: 24 in collabDetailModel.test.js, rewritten to the real six
verification.mutation: 7 deliberate breakages, 7 caught — one only after I closed a gap in my own guard, which never tested the fallback itself

scope_excluded: Sending a briefed creator straight to signing — a different change, needs the contract created at briefing rather than on acceptance

release.outward_facing: None to shoppers. Large for creators — a screen that was unusable starts working.
release.device_walk_required: YES. W3 especially — the sections restored past signing have not rendered since Stage 1, so the screens behind them may have drifted while nothing reached them.
